ambiguity.detail: Flash-forward references a destroyed home not yet explained in the main scene.

verdict.hook_line: They took our home. I will not let them take anything else now.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: But every day, he gives me another reason to trust him.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A married couple finds quiet, tender moments of safety and growing trust amid hidden dangers.
verdict.why_it_works: Strong emotional contrast between a hard-hitting vengeance cold open and a tender, romantic fireside bonding scene.
